text: I've been waiting over 40 mins for a callback so I'm writing it here. My son is 4, temp 39.1. About 20 mins ago I think he had a fit. His whole body went stiff and then he was shaking, his eyes rolled up. It's never happened before, not once. I don't know exactly how long it lasted, maybe a minute? He's had a sore throat since yesterday but he's been drinking ok. Can SOMEONE please actually ring me
